countries.title: Countries
countries.description: One or more ISO 3-letter country codes, e.g. "USA", "GBR", "JPN", "IND".

indicatorCode.title: Indicator code
indicatorCode.description: A World Bank indicator code. Common ones: NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (GDP, current US$), NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG (GDP growth %), FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG (inflation %), SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS (unemployment %), SP.POP.TOTL (population), SP.DYN.LE00.IN (life expectancy). Browse more at data.worldbank.org/indicator.

mostRecentYears.title: Most recent years
mostRecentYears.description: How many of the most recent years (per country) to return.
